name: Suitcase Carry
common_faults: lateral lean toward the load (giving in to the side flexion)
shoulder shrugging on the loaded side

substitutions.note: anti-rotation; trunk stability from a different angle

resistance_profile: constant anti-lateral-flexion demand on the contralateral oblique and QL throughout the carry

provenance.notes: Unilateral loaded carry. Trains lateral trunk stability and gait under asymmetric load. Spine health benefit via anti-lateral-flexion demand.
